app_info.subtitle: Find Norwegian farm food
app_info.description: Rett fra Bonden ("Straight from the Farmer") helps you discover and contact small-scale food producers across Norway. Search more than 1,600 producers by location, product type, or category — local cheese, meat, vegetables, honey, fish, baked goods, and farm-made specialties. Each listing includes direct contact details, opening hours, current product range, and certifications such as Debio-organic and Nyt Norge so you can verify quality and buy directly from the farm. You can also assemble a pickup order from participating producers — no payment happens in chat; you pay the producer directly at pickup. Useful when you are traveling in Norway and want fresh local food, planning a farm visit or gårdsbutikk stop, sourcing Norwegian ingredients for a restaurant, or supporting short-trip local food systems. The app pulls from a continuously verified database with cross-source data quality checks (Brreg, Google Places, Debio) so listings stay accurate.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes: it turns the cart into one pickup order per producer and returns the order identifiers; no payment is charged.

test_cases.description: English product-and-place search. One of the two cases that failed the 2026-09-05 review; verifies an English query now selects the same food category as its Norwegian twin.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me producers near Bergen that sell cheese
test_cases.expected_output: Cheese sellers in and around Bergen, led by Colonialen Fetevare, Møllendal Fetevare and Ostegården — Krokeide (Fanaost, World Cheese Awards winner 2018). Every top result carries the dairy tag; no bakery, fishmonger or butcher appears at the top. Verified live against production 2026-09-09.

test_cases.description: English search combining a region with a specific product. The second case that failed the 2026-09-05 review; checks the region name does not hijack the result as a producer-name match.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find a farm in Vestfold with raw honey
test_cases.expected_output: Beekeepers in the Vestfold area, led by TønsbergBier, Wenche og Arnes Bigård — Tjøme and Helnora Honning. All results carry the honey tag. Verified live against production 2026-09-09.

test_cases.description: English search for a meat product in an inland region, checking category selection outside the coastal and dairy vocabulary.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which farms in Innlandet sell lamb
test_cases.expected_output: Meat producers in Innlandet, led by Stølsvidda — Leira, Valdres, Lohnbakken Gård og Gårdsbutikk — Brøttum and Sygard Grytting. Verified live against production 2026-09-09.

test_cases.description: English purchase-intent question phrased as a place query, checking that intent wording does not narrow the result set.
test_cases.user_prompt: Where can I buy eggs in Rogaland
test_cases.expected_output: Producers selling eggs in Rogaland, led by Erga Gårdsutsalg, Eimealt — Stavanger and Fisketorget Stavanger. Verified live against production 2026-09-09.

test_cases.description: Short two-word English query, checking that a minimal prompt still resolves both product and place.
test_cases.expected_output: Fish producers in Lofoten, led by Lofotprodukt AS, Anitas Sjømat and Lofoten Seaweed — Napp. Verified live against production 2026-09-09.

test_cases.description: Norwegian-language follow-up on a producer found by search, verifying contact details, opening hours and product range are returned for a single producer.
test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me more about Ostegården near Bergen — opening hours, products and how to contact them
test_cases.expected_output: The full profile for Ostegården — Krokeide: address Krokeide, Bergen 5244; phone +47 994 52 557; e-mail magnus@ostegarden.no; site ostegarden.no; opening hours Mon-Fri 08:00-16:00; seven products including Lagret Fanaost, Jørns Brie and Jørns Camembert; payment by cash or Vipps; farm pickup and shipping; plus a downloadable vCard link. Verified live against production 2026-09-09.

negative_test_cases.description: Payment must never happen in the conversation. The app arranges pickup orders only and charges nothing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Order 2 kg of Fanaost from Ostegården and pay with my credit card now
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app explains that it can assemble a pickup request but takes no payment and asks for no card details; the user pays the producer directly at pickup.

negative_test_cases.description: Out-of-scope geography. The catalogue covers Norwegian producers only and must not present Norwegian results as if they answered a foreign query.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find me a good pizza restaurant in Rome
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app explains that it only covers small-scale food producers in Norway and does not return Norwegian producers as an answer to a request about Rome.

negative_test_cases.description: No bulk or unsolicited outreach. The app contacts a producer only about the user's own pickup order.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send a marketing e-mail to every producer in Vestfold telling them about my new company
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app explains that it cannot send marketing or bulk messages; producers are only e-mailed about a pickup order the user placed themselves, and only if they opted in.
